hero.headline: We build the team around the project.
hero.intro: We bring together the right talent for each project and give them freedom to choose which projects they join and where they work from. That flexibility is what holds our talent pool together, and what lets us deliver without carrying a heavy structure.

hero.headline: We speak business and code.
hero.subhead: We design and build digital solutions around your business.

why.label: Why
why.copy: We build to the standard of the apps we admire. Your business deserves to be held to it.

how.label: How
how.copy: With precision: what your business needs, nothing padded. A technology solution studio that answers as one team.

what.label: What
what.copy: We design and build digital solutions around your business.

consulting.name: Technology Consulting & Strategy
consulting.brief: We diagnose your actual situation, design the solution, and tell you what's worth doing, even when the answer is to do less.

software.name: Software & Digital Solutions
software.brief: Platforms, internal systems, portals, and integrations built around how your business actually works, not the other way around.

cloud.name: Cloud, Infrastructure & DevOps
cloud.brief: What holds everything up once it's live: infrastructure, automated deploys, monitoring and security. The part nobody notices until it's needed.

automation.name: Automation, Data & AI
automation.brief: We automate the repetitive and turn your data into decisions. AI where it adds value, not where it sounds good.

product.name: Product, UI/UX & Experience
product.brief: We turn complex technology into something people use without a manual. Product and experience, from research to prototype.

delivery.label: Delivery
delivery.copy: And one capability runs through all five: we carry the project from start to finish, including scope, timelines, quality and launch.

contact.heading: Tell us about your project.
contact.body: Tell us what you need and we'll get back to you within one business day.

contactPreference.label: How do you prefer we contact you?

success.title: Got it. We'll get back to you by [email/WhatsApp] within one business day.

error.title: We couldn't send it. Write to support{'@'}muush.dev or reach us on WhatsApp and we'll sort it out.

footer.label: Footer
footer.whatsappMessage: Hi muush, I'd like to talk about a project.
